payload.title: All 39 councillors voted, and added £313,000 of their own items
payload.summary: Budget Council on 24 February 2026 passed the statutory resolution setting the city council's share of a Band D bill at £315.26, on a council tax requirement of £12,549,520 across 39,807 properties. The Labour group added £313,000 of items to the main motion, funded from the 2026/27 contingency, and the Green and Liberal Democrat groups tabled costed amendments of their own.
detail: The £313,000 covers fly-tipping and graffiti enforcement, communal-area improvements, community clean-up activity and political assistant provision.
The other groups proposed a £65,000 ward-level community cohesion fund at £5,000 a ward, and £45,000 for planting 100 trees at a stated officer price of £459 each.
This is the stage where a Norwich budget demonstrably changes. The consultation result did not move the tax figure; amendments at Cabinet and Council have moved spending in several recent years.
